mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) compresses discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. This signal is always active when the rate is below 0.5%.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly positive in periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.5% (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A high unemployment rate (UNRATE > 8.0%) signals a weak labor market and economic distress, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly negative when UNRATE > 8.0% (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment (UNRATE) is rising and industrial production (INDPRO) is falling, it indicates a deteriorating economic cycle, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction condition (UNRATE rising and INDPRO falling) fails to produce negative 20-day returns in more than 40% of instances (or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows).

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle (defined by FEDFUNDS > 2.0% and rising for 3 months), the S&P 500 experiences negative forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to increased discount rates and reduced liquidity.
failure_condition: The hypothesis fails if S&P 500 60-day returns are not significantly negative during periods when FEDFUNDS > 2.0% and rising for 3 months (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST < 500) signals weak consumer demand and economic slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly negative when HOUST < 500 (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Strong retail sales (RSAFS > 400000) indicate robust consumer spending and economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly positive when RSAFS > 400000 (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A low level of industrial production (INDPRO < 100) signals weak manufacturing activity and reduced economic growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are not significantly negative when INDPRO < 100 (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A low level of industrial production (INDPRO < 100) is associated with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, reflecting a prolonged economic slowdown in the manufacturing sector.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are not significantly negative when INDPRO < 100 (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows falls below 0.03.
